tbesh_html:
1) to bear news, bear tidings, publish, preach, show forth
1a) (Piel)
1a1) to gladden with good news
1a2) to bear news
1a3) to announce (salvation) as good news, preach
1b) (Hithpael) to receive good news

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to be fresh, i.e. full (rosy, (figuratively) cheerful); to announce (glad news)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: messenger, preach, publish, shew forth, (bear, bring, carry, preach, good, tell good) tidings.
